map.Kupperman绝经期症状评分，评估围绝经期症状严重程度(加权评分法): Kupperman menopausal symptom score, assesses perimenopausal severity (weighted method)
map.改良 Kupperman 指数 = Σ（13 项症状权重 × 程度 0–3），权: Modified Kupperman index = sum(13 symptom weights x severity 0-3), total weight 21, max 63; <=6 normal, 7-15 mild, 16-30 moderate, 31 or above severe; hot flashes have the highest weight (x4).
map.各症状严重度：0=无，1=轻度，2=中度，3=重度。症状分 = 基本分 × 严重: Severity: 0=none, 1=mild, 2=moderate, 3=severe. Symptom score = base x severity
map.强烈建议MHT或系统治疗: Strongly advise MHT or systemic therapy
map.是缓解绝经相关症状最有效的方法。需在医生指导下，评估适应证、禁忌证后个体化用药，: The most effective relief for menopausal symptoms. Under medical guidance, assess indications/contraindications, individualize, and follow up regularly.
map.提示：改良 Kupperman 指数是经典的围绝经期症状评估工具（13 项、满分: Tip: the modified Kupperman index is a classic perimenopausal symptom tool (13 items, max 63); hot flashes carry the highest weight (x4). A score of 16 or above indicates moderate or worse symptoms; seek assessment. For screening reference only.
map.围绝经期女性量化潮热、失眠等症状严重程度。: Quantify severity of hot flashes, insomnia, etc. in perimenopausal women.
map.Kupperman 满分多少？: What is the maximum Kupperman score?
map.不能单独诊断，需结合月经史、 FSH 与雌激素水平；评分用于量化严重度与治疗反应: Cannot diagnose alone; needs menstrual history, FSH and estrogen; used to quantify severity and treatment response.
map.更年期(Kupperman)评分器，评估围绝经期症状严重程度，指导激素替代治疗决: The Kupperman tool assesses perimenopausal severity and guides MHT decisions. A professional medical tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
map.本页采用国内常用的改良 Kupperman 指数（13 项加权、满分 63）分级: This page uses the commonly used modified Kupperman index (13 weighted items, maximum 63). The original Kupperman index (Abe modification, maximum 51) uses 15–20/21–35/≥36 cutoffs; scores from the two versions are not interchangeable.
map.潮热（权重 4）×重度 3 = 12 分、失眠（权重 2）×中度 2 = 4 分: Hot flashes (weight 4) x severe 3 = 12, insomnia (weight 2) x moderate 2 = 4, irritability (weight 2) x moderate 2 = 4; total 20, moderate (16–30); medical evaluation for MHT is advised.
map.仅潮热（权重 4）×轻度 1 = 4 分、骨关节痛（权重 1）×轻度 1 = 1: Only hot flashes (weight 4) x mild 1 = 4 and joint pain (weight 1) x mild 1 = 1; total 5, ≤6 is essentially normal; start with lifestyle measures.
map.改良版共 13 项、权重合计 21，各项乘严重程度 0–3 分累加，满分 63；: The modified version has 13 items with total weight 21; each item is multiplied by severity 0–3, giving a maximum of 63. Grades: ≤6 essentially normal, 7–15 mild, 16–30 moderate, ≥31 severe. The original Kupperman index (Abe modification, maximum 51) uses 15–20/21–35/≥36 cutoffs; do not mix the two scoring systems.
